Hi Jimmy,

Thanks for following up, and happy to give you where things stand today.

Your order Shop···· is paid and waiting on stock. The date on your order for the Magic Miner 40T is October 31, and I want to be straight with you: the units for the US warehouse are still being built at the factory, so I don't yet have a confirmed date for them landing with us. I'd rather tell you that than guess a date.

The good news is your order number sits inside the first US shipment's coverage, so you're on that one. You can watch it move from the factory to our warehouse here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

The Harlo OS Diagnostics and 3-Month RMA goes out in the same box. As soon as the label is printed you'll get the tracking number by email at this address.

Thanks for your patience, Jimmy.

Sarah
HeliumDeploy Support
